assets.name: ma12-barrel-vase-v1.png
assets.description: (1400 × 2000 px): one empty, clear glass vase seen exactly side-on (no perspective tilt of the rim beyond a thin ellipse), standing upright and centred, a smooth barrel shape: narrow at the base, widest at mid-height, narrow again at the open mouth, symmetric top to bottom, on a short flat glass foot. Clear glass with light edge highlights only; the inside must read as empty and see-through so that a coded water fill can show inside it. **Paint the inner wall to this profile** (inner height 1600 px from the inside of the base to the mouth; inner radius given at 11 equally spaced heights from the base, as a fraction of the widest inner radius, which is 511 px): 0.447, 0.486, 0.541, 0.629, 0.790, 1.000, 0.790, 0.629, 0.541, 0.486, 0.447. So the inner base and the mouth are each about 457 px across and the widest inner width is about 1022 px, at exactly mid-height. The curve between the guide points is smooth (no corners). The glass wall sits outside this profile and is thin (about 10 to 14 px). Codex reports, in file pixels, the vase's vertical axis, the inside of the base, the mouth's inner rim and the measured inner half-width at the 11 guide heights.

assets.name: ma12-pen-wall-v1.png
assets.description: (2400 × 1400 px): an old dry-stone wall of grey-brown fieldstones, about chest height, running straight across the back of the picture from left to right; against it, a rectangular pen of plain timber post-and-rail fencing (two rails, posts evenly spaced) on three sides: two sides run from the wall towards the viewer and one side runs parallel to the wall at the front. Low three-quarter view from the front left, so all three fence sides and the wall face are visible. The pen is about twice as long along the wall as it is deep. Short green grass inside the pen and on a narrow strip around it, the ground patch ending in a soft, irregular transparent edge (no sky, no horizon, no buildings, no trees). **Empty: no animals** (a separate sheep plate is placed inside) and no gate. Codex reports, in file pixels: the midpoints of the left side, the front side and the right side of the fence, the midpoint of the wall's length inside the pen, and a ground point near the centre of the pen where a sheep can stand.
